# scripts/mutation-pr.sh over a stub gremlins and a small report: the contract with the remediation workflow.
# A lived mutant is one line that starts with "finding: ". The gremlins log lines and the summary line carry no such prefix.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:git] skip
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
chmod 755 fake/gremlins
chmod 755 fake/timeout
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH

# The repository has the module and the script at its top folder, a base commit and a change to a Go source file.
exec git init -q -b main repo
cp a.go repo/a.go
cp gomod repo/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
script mutation-exec.sh repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
chmod 755 repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
exec git -C repo add a.go go.mod scripts
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b change
cp a2.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m change

# A report with one lived, one killed, one timed out and one uncovered mutant: one finding line, for the lived one only.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/lived.json
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t0\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout -count=1 '^finding: '
stdout '^finding: a.go:3: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=3 killed=1 lived=1 timed_out=1$'
stdout '^      KILLED CONDITIONALS_NEGATION at a.go:30:4$'
! stdout 'finding: a.go:4'
! stdout 'finding: a.go:5'
! stdout 'finding: a.go:6'
stdout '^mutation-pr: 1 mutant\(s\) lived, 1 finding line\(s\) printed\. Kill each one with a test\.$'
# The engine reads the lived mutant from its marker line, after the counts line, and the end marker is the last "mutation-pr:" line.
stdout -count=1 '^mutation-pr: lived '
stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: applied=3 .*^mutation-pr: lived a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=1 printed=1$'
! stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: end .*^mutation-pr: '

# Gremlins reads LIVED for a test run that exited 1, too. The records hold the exit code of each run. A lived mutant whose run
# exited 1 is an error of the run: no finding, no marker line, no count in the end marker, and a failed run. The counts line keeps the mutant.
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t1\t--- FAIL: TestF (0.01s)\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=3 killed=1 lived=1 timed_out=1$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: run error a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION: the test run exited with code 1: --- FAIL: TestF \(0\.01s\)$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: 1 mutant\(s\) lived with a test run that did not exit 0\. That is an error of the run, not a weak test: read the run error lines\.$'
! stdout '^finding: '
! stdout '^mutation-pr: lived '
! stdout 'Kill each one with a test'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'
! stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: end .*^mutation-pr: '

# A run that a signal ended: the record holds the exit code of the shell, 128 plus the signal number.
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t137\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: run error a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION: the test run ended with exit code 137, a kill by signal 9$'
! stdout '^finding: '
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'

# A lived mutant with no record: go test never ran the tests, or a signal ended it before the record. That is an error of the run, too.
env GREMLINS_RECORDS=
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: run error a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION: no exit code was recorded for the test run of this mutant$'
! stdout '^finding: '
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'

# Two lived mutants of one token, as gremlins reports them for ">": a boundary mutant and a negation mutant, both at column 5.
# The boundary mutant adds the "=" after the token, so its record has the token as the byte before the change (after=5). The
# negation mutant has its record at column 5.
# The boundary run exited 0 and the negation run exited 1: one finding and one error of the run, whatever the order of the records.
# The end marker counts the finding only, and the counts line counts both.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/twolived.json
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t1\tFAIL a 0.01s\na.go\t3\t7\t5\t0\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=2 killed=0 lived=2 timed_out=0$'
stdout -count=1 '^finding: a\.go:3: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: run error a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION: the test run exited with code 1: FAIL a 0\.01s$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: 1 mutant\(s\) lived, 1 finding line\(s\) printed\. Kill each one with a test\.$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: 1 mutant\(s\) lived with a test run that did not exit 0\.'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=1 printed=1$'
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t7\t5\t0\t\na.go\t3\t5\t4\t1\tFAIL a 0.01s\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout -count=1 '^finding: a\.go:3: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: run error a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION: the test run exited with code 1: FAIL a 0\.01s$'
# A record at the column of the boundary mutant, with no record at the column after it, is not a record of the boundary mutant.
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t0\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: run error a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY: no exit code was recorded for the test run of this mutant$'
stdout -count=1 '^finding: a\.go:3: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$'
! stdout 'finding: a\.go:3: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY'

# Two mutators share one place, as for "+=": one is killed (its run exited 1), one lived (its run exited 0). Gremlins gives the
# test run no mutator, so the killed mutant takes the record with exit code 1 and the lived mutant is weak.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/sharedplace.json
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t1\tFAIL a 0.01s\na.go\t3\t5\t4\t0\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout -count=1 '^finding: a\.go:3: a mutant lived: REMOVE_SELF_ASSIGNMENTS$'
! stdout 'run error'
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=1 printed=1$'
# The records of a place where the mutant that lived is the only one, and a late record of a cancelled mutant is also there,
# disagree. The message says so and names no failing test.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/onelived.json
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t1\tFAIL late 0.01s\na.go\t3\t5\t4\t0\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: run error a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION: ambiguous: the test runs recorded at this place exited with codes 0 and 1, and the records do not tell which run belongs to this mutant$'
! stdout 'FAIL late'
! stdout '^finding: '
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'

# A mutant that gremlins stopped on a timeout keeps running, and its late record can say exit 0. The record is not read for any
# mutant, so the lived mutant at the same place has no record: an error of the run, not a weak test.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/timedlate.json
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t0\t\n'
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: run error a\.go:3 CONDITIONALS_NEGATION: no exit code was recorded for the test run of this mutant$'
! stdout '^finding: '
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'

# A run that gremlins ends with a failure leaves no report. The recorded runs are the only evidence, so the script prints them.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/lived.json
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t1\t--- FAIL: TestF (0.01s)\n'
env GREMLINS_STATUS=3
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: gremlins exited with status 3$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: test run of a\.go:3:5 exited with 1: --- FAIL: TestF \(0\.01s\)$'
env GREMLINS_RECORDS=
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: no mutant test run left an exit code record$'
env GREMLINS_STATUS=

# A run that passes its time limit leaves no report. Each record is printed beside the verdict that gremlins wrote for its place,
# so a killed mutant does not read like an error. A place with no verdict line says so.
# A boundary mutant pairs by the byte before the change: its token is at column 5 and its record names column 7 and after=5.
# Gremlins prints a colour code around the status when it writes to a terminal, so the verdict of line 8 holds one.
env GREMLINS_RECORDS='a.go\t3\t5\t4\t1\t--- FAIL: TestF (0.01s)\na.go\t4\t5\t4\t0\t\na.go\t6\t5\t4\t1\tFAIL\na.go\t7\t7\t5\t0\t\na.go\t8\t5\t4\t1\tFAIL\n'
env GREMLINS_VERDICTS='      KILLED CONDITIONALS_NEGATION at a.go:3:5\n       LIVED ARITHMETIC_BASE at a.go:4:5\n       LIVED CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY at a.go:7:5\n\0033[32m      KILLED\0033[0m INVERT_NEGATIVES at a.go:8:5\n'
env GREMLINS_STATUS=124
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: the run exceeded MUTATION_TIMEOUT=1200s$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: test run of a\.go:3:5 exited with 1: --- FAIL: TestF \(0\.01s\). Gremlins wrote KILLED CONDITIONALS_NEGATION for this place\.$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: test run of a\.go:4:5 exited with 0. Gremlins wrote LIVED ARITHMETIC_BASE for this place\.$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: test run of a\.go:6:5 exited with 1: FAIL. Gremlins wrote no verdict for this place\.$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: test run of a\.go:7:7 exited with 0\. Gremlins wrote LIVED CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY for this place\.$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: test run of a\.go:8:5 exited with 1: FAIL\. Gremlins wrote KILLED INVERT_NEGATIVES for this place\.$'
env GREMLINS_VERDICTS=
env GREMLINS_STATUS=

# Every "go test" of gremlins reads GOFLAGS: each test binary runs through the script that records its exit code, with no cached run.
# A GOFLAGS of the environment stays in front of the two flags of the script.
env GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/clean.json
env GREMLINS_RECORDS=
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^fake gremlins GOFLAGS=-mod=mod -count=1 -exec=.*/repo/scripts/mutation-exec\.sh -timeout=1200s$'
stdout '^fake gremlins MUTATION_ROOT=.*/repo$'
env GOFLAGS=

# A GOFLAGS that "go env -w" wrote is a file value, and a GOFLAGS variable replaces it in go. The script merges the value that go reads.
env GOENV=$WORK/goenv
exec go env -w GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^fake gremlins GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly -count=1 -exec=.*/repo/scripts/mutation-exec\.sh -timeout=1200s$'
env GOENV=

# A script that is not executable makes every mutant fail to start, which go test reports as exit 1 (KILLED),
# so the run stops before gremlins starts.
chmod 644 repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout 'mutation-exec\.sh is not an executable file$'
! stdout 'fake gremlins'
chmod 755 repo/scripts/mutation-exec.sh

# A report with no lived mutant: the script passes and prints no finding, no marker line and the end marker with count 0.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/clean.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=1 killed=1 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
! stdout '^finding: '
! stdout '^mutation-pr: lived '
stdout '^mutation-pr: end count=0 printed=0$'
! stdout '(?s)^mutation-pr: end .*^mutation-pr: '

-- gomod --
module example.com/r

go 1.27
-- a.go --
package a
-- a2.go --
package a

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
func G(x int) int  { return x + 1 }
func H(x int) int  { return -x }
func I(x int)      { x++ }
-- fake/gremlins --
#!/bin/sh
cp "$GREMLINS_REPORT" "$5"
[ -z "${GREMLINS_RECORDS:-}" ] || printf '%b' "$GREMLINS_RECORDS" >>"$MUTATION_EXIT_LOG"
echo "fake gremlins GOFLAGS=$GOFLAGS"
echo "fake gremlins MUTATION_ROOT=$MUTATION_ROOT"
echo "      KILLED CONDITIONALS_NEGATION at a.go:30:4"
[ -z "${GREMLINS_VERDICTS:-}" ] || printf '%b' "$GREMLINS_VERDICTS"
exit "${GREMLINS_STATUS:-0}"
-- fake/timeout --
#!/bin/sh
shift 3
exec "$@"
-- lived.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"LIVED"},{"line":4,"column":5,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"KILLED"},{"line":5,"column":5,"type":"INVERT_NEGATIVES","status":"TIMED OUT"},{"line":6,"column":5,"type":"INCREMENT_DECREMENT","status":"NOT COVERED"}]}]}
-- twolived.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_BOUNDARY","status":"LIVED"},{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"LIVED"}]}]}
-- sharedplace.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"INVERT_ASSIGNMENTS","status":"KILLED"},{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"REMOVE_SELF_ASSIGNMENTS","status":"LIVED"}]}]}
-- onelived.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"LIVED"}]}]}
-- timedlate.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"LIVED"},{"line":3,"column":5,"type":"INVERT_NEGATIVES","status":"TIMED OUT"}]}]}
-- clean.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
